profile_text.body:
Figure AI is an AI robotics company that describes itself as the first of its kind, focused on developing a general-purpose humanoid robot. The company's stated mission centers on bringing that humanoid to life, positioning its work at the intersection of physical-world interaction and embodied artificial intelligence.

The site's held facts categorize Figure AI's work under emerging and frontier AI, with notes referencing humanoid robotics, safety-critical applications, and embodied AI governance. No litigation, SEC filings, MCP servers, or patent records are present in the available data.
